anyOf.description: A theme defineTheme made: an installed look, or one of the App's own. It extends a built-in look itself; a theme is never more than two deep.

extends.description: Start from a built-in look, or from a theme, and say only what differs. Without it, colors names ground, surface, ink and accent in both modes and the rest is derived.

colors.description: Required, with ground, surface, ink and accent in both modes, unless the theme extends a built-in; then partial.

palettes.description: Named color variations over the theme's own colors. IDs must be unique within the theme, checked by the App parser.

defaultPalette.description: default or a declared palette id; references are checked by the App parser.

scheme.description: dark: worn dark until the reader picks a mode themselves, whatever their machine is set to; it still has light colors, held to a printed page's white paper. dark-only: no light colors at all, colors names dark alone, the theme is judged as dark and not as paper, and a reader cannot turn it light. Omitted, the theme follows the reader and their machine.

control.description: A button's, an input's and a select's corner, 0px to 16px, or `round`: a pill (every other box that follows it takes 8px).

pill.description: A status pill's, a tag's and a chip's corner, 0px to 12px or `round`; omitted, round.

panel.description: A card's, a section's and a dialog's corner, 0px to 20px; omitted, one and a half controls', at most 20px.

elevation.description: A preset as its look draws it (flat: Mono, no lift; hairline: the platform's; soft: Sage; raised: Lumen), or a step for cards and one for what floats over the base's, each none, hairline, low (the platform's popups), mid (Sage's) or high (Lumen's).

card.description: The cards a recipe draws: a section, a field group or a stat boxed by section, fields or stat.

float.description: What floats: a menu, a popover, a drawer; a dialog a step above.

rule.description: The rules over a section and a board's lanes and under a table's heads; omitted, the look's (2px, Lumen 1px).

control.description: A field's and a select's edge; omitted, 1px. `0px` draws none, and `check` refuses it unless `colors.field` stands apart from the ground and the surface (1.08:1); the focus ring is then the edge.

panel.description: A card's and a section's edge where the look draws one; 0px draws none. Omitted, 1px.

control.description: A field's, a select's and a button's height, 32px to 56px; omitted, 34px. A touch screen keeps a 44px floor.

faces.description: Font files from the App's directory, each one @font-face served from the App's own origin. The heading's face is preloaded on first paint.

family.description: The family name a type.font stack names it by.

src.description: A .woff2 or .woff file inside the App's directory, relative to it: ./fonts/workshop-mono.woff2.

weight.description: 100 to 900, or a variable file's range as "100 900". Omitted, 400.

subset.description: Omitted, the file is cut to Latin when the App loads; false ships it whole, for an App written in another script.

icons.description: The icons’ weight, from Phosphor’s: regular (omitted), light, bold or fill. Thin and duotone are refused: a 1px stroke fades at an icon’s 16px, and a second tone is a color no role says.

base.description: The size an App’s text is drawn at; every size grows with it, the roles’ too. Omitted, 13px.

roles.description: Each kind of text by what it is for, saying only what differs from the look. Body, data, label and nav text has no size of its own: it follows type.base.

display.description: A landing’s headline: its face, size (28px to 56px), leading, tracking, weight and features.

title.description: A record’s and a dashboard’s name: its face, size (20px to 36px), leading, tracking, weight, case and features; its weight is every heading’s.

heading.description: A list naming itself over its rows: its face, size (16px to 28px), leading, tracking, weight (omitted, the title’s), case and features.

section.description: A section’s title on a record and a dashboard: its face, case and features; a dashboard’s section title also takes a size (12px to 20px), tracking and weight.

body.description: Prose, fields and the interface, at the base size: its leading (1.35 to 1.8) and features.

label.description: A column’s head, a stat’s label and a record’s tabs, at the base size: their face, tracking, weight (400 to 700), case and features; upper sets them a step smaller.

data.description: A table’s cells and a record’s values, in the data face at the base size: their features, tabular figures kept, and its reach: every value, or figures only (figures, keys and dates, a record header’s facts too).

reach.description: values (omitted): every value in the data face; figures: only figures, keys and dates, names in the interface face.

figure.description: A stat’s figure: its face, size (18px to 40px), tracking, weight and features, tabular figures kept.

nav.description: The menu’s entries in the bar, at the base size: their face, tracking, weight (400 to 600) and case; upper sets them a step smaller.

motion.description: How fast things enter: house (omitted) as the platform moves, brisk a quarter quicker, still with nothing entering, as reduced motion draws it. A reader who asks for reduced motion gets still under every pace.

rhythm.description: How far apart things stand: house (omitted) as the platform spaces a page, tight its layout steps (16px and up, and the section seam) a quarter closer, airy a quarter wider. A control's own padding never moves.

nav.description: `tint`: The current entry sits on a soft tint of the accent; the other rows stay plain. `inverted`: The current entry is inverted, the menu’s ink as its ground: the boldest mark, square and high-contrast. `wash`: The current entry sits on a wash of the menu’s own accent, stronger than tint, for a menu in a brand color. `underline`: The current entry in the top bar is marked by a 3px rule of the menu’s accent under it, with no fill. `pill`: Every row is a rounded pill with room around it; the current one is filled in the accent’s tint, its word in the accent. `quiet`: The current entry is barely shaded in the menu’s ink, with no accent at all: the calmest mark. `slot`: The current entry is an ink block, as inverted, with a 3px marker of the menu’s accent beside it, like a tool’s slot on a pegboard.

bar.description: `plain`: The top bar is the menu’s ground with a hairline under it. `ruled`: The top bar ends in a 2px rule instead of a hairline, and casts no shadow. `dark`: The top bar takes the menu’s ground and inks, so a dark or brand-colored menu runs across the top too. `airy`: The top bar is taller, with a large bold brand name and a wide, raised search box. `soft`: The top bar is a panel in the surface color with a hairline under it, apart from the menu beside it.

tabs.description: `pill`: The chosen tab is a filled pill; the others are plain words. `inverted`: The chosen tab is inverted, the ink as its ground: square, high-contrast. `underline`: The tabs stand on a hairline, wide apart, the chosen one underlined in the accent with no fill. `rule`: The chosen tab is underlined by a 2px rule in the link color with no fill, the tabs packed as written. `chosen`: The chosen tab sits on a soft tint of the accent in the ink, wider apart, with no underline.

windows.description: `segmented`: The period picker is a segmented control, the chosen period filled. `lifted`: The period picker is a sunken tray, the chosen period a raised white key on it. `chosen`: The period picker has no tray; the chosen period sits on a soft tint of the accent.

stat.description: `plain`: A stat is a figure and its label with no frame. `framed`: Each stat is a card framed by a line in the ink: square and stark. `topline`: Each stat card has a 3px rule in the first chart color along its top. `ruled`: Each stat stands open under a 2px rule in the ink, with no card or shadow, like a printed page. `icon`: Each stat is a card with its icon in a round tint of a chart color above the label, and a large bold figure. `panel`: Each stat is a panel on the surface with a hairline and the look’s card shadow. `divided`: The stats share one strip, parted by hairlines, with no cards: the quietest arrangement.

section.description: `open`: A dashboard section stands open on the page under its rule. `card`: Each dashboard section is a card with a hairline and the card shadow, its table drawn to the card’s edges. `panel`: Each dashboard section is a panel like card, but a section in the side column stays open on the page.

fields.description: `open`: A record’s field groups and forms stand open on the page. `panel`: Each field group and form is a panel on the surface with a hairline; its labels stay as the look draws them. `card`: Each field group and form is a card with a hairline and the card shadow, its labels muted and the values in the interface face. `rail`: Field groups stand open, and the side column’s cards become captioned groups between hairlines.

table.description: `open`: Rows stand on the page under a rule, the head as the look draws it. `tinted`: As open, but a hovered row takes a tint of the accent and its check boxes the accent: the same until a pointer moves. `hairline`: The head sits on a hairline in 12.5px semibold, the rows in 13.5px: open, a little roomier. `card`: The table is a card: muted 12px heads on a hairline, faint row rules and taller rows. `quiet`: The table is a card of quiet rows, a work queue’s open button folded to a chevron at the row’s end. `banded`: As open, but every other row lies on the band color (colors.band, or the raised ground), each ink measured on it.

status.description: `dot`: A status word in its tone with a dot before it. `pill`: A status word on a pill tinted with its tone, without a dot. `pill-dot`: A status word on a pill tinted with its tone, with a small dot inside it. `quiet`: A status word in the ink with a dot in its tone: the color is only the dot.

board.description: `ruled`: A board’s lanes are outlined by a hairline; its cards lie flat on them. `soft`: As ruled, but each card casts the look’s card shadow: only the cards lift. `strip`: Each lane is headed by a strip tinted with its tone, its cards white on the lane.

chart.description: `plain`: A chart is its lines or bars on a light grid. `wash`: An area under a line is washed in the first chart color. `gradient`: An area fades from the line down to nothing, the line heavier and the grid dashed. `line`: Only the lines: no areas, a fine solid grid and small ticks.

buttons.description: `accent`: The primary button is filled in the accent; the rest are quiet. `raised`: Secondary buttons are white keys with a hairline and a small shadow, raised off the page. `keyed`: Buttons are hard-edged keys: the primary one filled in the accent with an ink edge, like a hazard tag, the rest edged in the ink.

links.description: `plain`: A link to another record is in the link color without an underline. `underline`: A link to another record is underlined, so it reads as one without color.

rules.description: `ink`: A record’s sections are announced by a 2px rule in the ink. `hairline`: A record’s sections are announced by a 1px hairline instead. `double`: A 1px hairline announces a record’s sections as in hairline, a box is ruled in the strong line, and a table’s heads close with a double rule.

avatar.description: `plain`: A record’s avatar is its initials in a small square. `large`: A record’s avatar is 44px, in the look’s corners. `round`: A record’s avatar is 44px and round, and the menu’s and the account’s marks are round too.

workflow.description: `markers`: A workflow is a track of thin segments, the label under each. `pills`: A workflow is a row of pills with a dot each: a step walked in the good tint, the current one in the accent’s.

banner.description: `tint`: A dashboard’s banner note is a box tinted with the accent. `gradient`: A dashboard’s banner note is a soft gradient from the accent to the second chart color. `plain`: A dashboard’s banner note stands on the page with no box, its eyebrow in the link color.

steps.description: `flat`: A breakdown drawn as steps is a row of cards on the surface with a hairline. `tinted`: Each step’s card is tinted with its tone: good, warning, critical or the accent. `strip`: The steps are one strip of figures parted by hairlines, with no cards or marks.

lanes.description: `tint`: A board lane’s value in its head is on its tone’s tint. `tag`: A board lane’s value is a solid tag in its tone, in white capitals. `plain`: A board lane’s value is its name in plain ink.

header.description: `plain`: A record’s head and a list’s stand on the page’s ground, under the trail’s hairline. `band`: A record’s head and a list’s are one band of the raised ground from edge to edge: the trail, the title, its status, facts and verbs, a list’s tabs and filters; the contents keep their edge. `hero`: A band, with the record’s avatar large beside its title (above it on a phone); a record without one, and a list, draw the band.

required.description: `star`: A required field wears a red star after its label; an optional one wears nothing. `optional-word`: A required field wears nothing and an optional one says “(optional)” after its label, quietly; the form’s own words, in the reader’s language.

checkbox.description: `native`: A checkbox is the browser’s own, in the accent. `drawn`: A checkbox is drawn: a square in the field’s fill with the control’s edge and corner, the accent with a check when on.

formStep.description: `plain`: A multi-step form’s step header is its title over its lead, with nothing between it and the fields. `ruled`: A multi-step form’s step header ends in a hairline, which parts it from the fields under it.

actionBar.description: `plain`: A form’s sticky action bar stands on a hairline over the page. `raised`: A form’s sticky action bar is raised on the surface with a soft lift, in place of the hairline.

recipes.description: Each part's treatment, from the closed menu the built-in looks wear.

shell.description: Where the menu is drawn, as a suggestion: it holds when this theme is the App's own (ui.theme.preset) and ui.shell.placement says nothing.

surface.description: A pattern behind the page (ground) and one behind the navigation (nav), drawn in the theme’s line color; never behind a panel or a field.

parts.description: Each published part’s own style, by its name: ground, bar, bar.search, nav, nav.item, nav.current, nav.group, logo, page.title, tabs, tab.current, section, section.title, stat, stat.figure, fields, field.label, table, table.head, table.row, status, tag, button.primary, button.secondary, button.quiet, link, board.lane, board.card, workflow.step, banner, steps.step, avatar, menu, dialog, chart. Contract 1: a 1.x release may publish another part and withdraws none.

stylesheet.description: A stylesheet beside the theme (8 KB at most) that styles its parts and nothing else: [data-part] selectors under the theme's own root, and only the properties the stylesheet allowlist names. Read once when the App loads; a build serves it from its brand/ folder.

contract.description: The theme contract a published look was written to. A theme written to another is refused, naming the release to install.

from.description: A published look's import.meta.url, so its faces and stylesheet are read from the package that holds them, never from the App that installs it. Requires contract.

field.description: A field's fill (text boxes, selects, pickers); the ink is checked at 4.5:1 on it. Omitted, `surface`. With `shape.border.control: '0px'` it must stand apart from the ground and the surface by 1.08:1.

shadow.description: The ink every lift is mixed from: a card's, a menu's, a dialog's shadow. Omitted, the look's (its ink by day, its ground by night). Never lighter than ground (theme-shadow).

band.description: Every other row of a banded table (recipes.table). Omitted, raised. Each ink is checked on it as on the page.

field.description: A field's fill (text boxes, selects, pickers); the ink is checked at 4.5:1 on it. Omitted, `surface`. With `shape.border.control: '0px'` it must stand apart from the ground and the surface by 1.08:1.

shadow.description: The ink every lift is mixed from: a card's, a menu's, a dialog's shadow. Omitted, the look's (its ink by day, its ground by night). Never lighter than ground (theme-shadow).

band.description: Every other row of a banded table (recipes.table). Omitted, raised. Each ink is checked on it as on the page.

kind.description: paper and grain a fine speckle, grid squares, dots a dot grid, lines ruled lines, scanlines a screen’s.

strength.description: How much of the line color it is drawn in: 1 (omitted) 40%, 2 70%, 3 all of it. check measures the words over its darkest point (theme-contrast).

colorPath.description: A color role by its path in colors, never a hex: check measures the pair in every mode and palette.

partStyle.description: One part’s colors by role, its corner, lift, face, weight and case. Nothing that moves a box: a part’s size, spacing, order and visibility are the App’s (theme-part).

ink.description: Its words; check measures them on its ground.

edge.description: Its border’s color, where it has one.

radius.description: One of the theme’s own corners, or square.

lift.description: A lift from the theme’s steps, in its shadow ink.

case.description: Capitals: upper or small-caps, tracked as the theme’s labels are; none undoes the look’s.
